attributes.note: Unlike the Travato, Winnebago publishes Solis pricing on its own Solis page: the 59P 'Starting At' $156,254 and the 59PX 'Starting At' $180,487, re-verified October 16, 2026. The figure shown is the 59P base.

Winnebago rates both floorplans at four: two in the rear bed (Murphy+ bed on the 59P, fold-down bed on the 59PX) and two in the pop-top loft. The pop-top berth is counted in the manufacturer's rating on both floorplans.

attributes.value: Enclosed wet bath with swiveling cassette toilet

attributes.note: 20 gal on both floorplans in Winnebago's Solis brochure, re-verified October 16, 2026.

attributes.value: Ceiling-to-floor insulation; interior waterlines; freeze-resistant exterior fill; Truma Combi Eco. Manufacturer attaches a winter-use-guidelines asterisk; not marketed as true four-season

attributes.note: Winnebago's Solis brochure lists 20 gal for both floorplans. Dealer spec feeds list 30 gal; the disagreement is logged in the conflicts below and the brochure figure is displayed.

attributes.value: 2 deep-cycle Group 31 AGM batteries; optional 5 kWh lithium (Winnebago x EcoFlow Power Kit Pro)

attributes.note: Winnebago publishes no standard inverter rating for the Solis. The 3,600W figure belongs to the optional EcoFlow Power Kit Pro's 5-in-1 power management controller, per the Solis brochure.

conflicts.note: Winnebago's Solis brochure lists a 20 gal gray tank for both the 59P and the 59PX. Dealer spec feeds (RVUSA's 2026 59P and 59PX spec blocks) list 30 gal. Individual dealer unit listings for 2025 Solis units list 20 gal, agreeing with the brochure. Logged October 16, 2026.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by policy (Mark, Oct 14, 2026): where sources disagree, the manufacturer's published figure is authoritative for display. The brochure figure (20 gal) is displayed and the disagreement stays logged.

name: Solis 59P
notes: Re-verified October 16, 2026 against Winnebago's Solis page and the current Solis brochure. Winnebago publishes Solis starting prices on its own page ($156,254 for the 59P; $180,487 for the 59PX), so the starting price is a manufacturer figure, unlike the Travato. Cross-check: Camping World lists 2026 59P MSRP $156,840 (agrees within options variance). One conflict logged: gray water (brochure 20 gal vs 30 gal in dealer spec feeds). Solis Pocket is a separate compact line (136in WB) and is not in the quiz pool.
